aurum.settings.title: Aurum
aurum.settings.phase_note: Version %s · Local lighting, sky and water controls
aurum.preset.tooltip: Low reduces rendering cost. High uses more shadow, relief and cloud detail. An individual edit switches to Custom.
aurum.option.sky_enabled.tooltip: Replaces the vanilla sky with the golden-hour sky.
aurum.option.sunset_intensity.tooltip: How strong the orange band at dawn and dusk is.
aurum.option.horizon_warmth.tooltip: Warmth of the horizon glow toward the sun.
aurum.option.rain_desaturation.tooltip: How much rain pulls the sky toward grey.
aurum.option.lighting_enabled.tooltip: Sun light, sky ambient and warmed block light on terrain.
aurum.option.sun_strength.tooltip: Strength of direct sun and moon light.
aurum.option.ambient_strength.tooltip: Strength of the sky-tinted ambient light in shade.
aurum.option.block_light_warmth.tooltip: How warm torches and lamps look.
aurum.option.ao_boost.tooltip: Extra depth on top of vanilla smooth lighting.
aurum.option.normals_enabled.tooltip: Bump detail baked from block textures at load. One texture read per pixel.
aurum.option.normal_strength.tooltip: Depth of the generated bump detail.
aurum.option.labpbr.tooltip:
Use _n and _s textures from a LabPBR resource pack when one is loaded.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.bounce_enabled.tooltip: Adds the cached, bounded neutral-wall bounce estimate to local block lighting. Requires the incident-light field; it does not tint the screen or fog.
aurum.option.bounce_strength.tooltip: Strength of the local single-bounce estimate. This is not full global illumination.
aurum.option.bloom_enabled.tooltip: Soft glow around the sun, lava and bright highlights.
aurum.option.sheen_enabled.tooltip: Shine and reflections on smooth blocks from a LabPBR resource pack.
aurum.option.sheen_strength.tooltip: How strongly smooth blocks reflect the sky, the sun and lamp light.
aurum.option.shadows_enabled.tooltip: Real shadows from the sun and moon. The most expensive effect.
aurum.option.shadow_resolution.tooltip: Sharper shadows at higher sizes. 1024 on Low. Medium and High also use softer 8-tap edges.
aurum.option.shadow_distance.tooltip: Shadows are drawn this far around you, then fade. Further costs more when the shadow map updates.
aurum.option.shadow_softness.tooltip: Width of the soft shadow edge.
aurum.option.entity_shadows.tooltip: Real shadows for players and mobs within 16 blocks, redrawn every frame. Costs some CPU; off on Low.
aurum.option.blob_shadows.tooltip: Mobs further than 16 blocks keep Minecraft's soft round shadow (uses the vanilla Entity Shadows video option).
aurum.option.fog_enabled.tooltip: Subtle fog that only appears at dawn, dusk, in rain, caves and swamps.
aurum.option.fog_strength.tooltip: Scales every kind of Aurum fog.
aurum.option.height_fog.tooltip: Low fog that settles in valleys.
aurum.option.edge_fade.tooltip: Light fade that hides the render distance edge.
aurum.option.water_enabled.tooltip:
Gentle water with depth colour and sky reflections.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.water_reflections.tooltip:
Water reflects the real sky, sunset and clouds.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.wave_strength.tooltip:
Height of the small surface ripples.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.vertex_waves.tooltip:
Very small real waves near you. Medium and High.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.foam.tooltip:
Soft foam along shores and around blocks.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.puddles.tooltip:
Ground gets wet and puddles form in rain, then dry over minutes.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.ground_reflections.tooltip:
Sky reflection on smooth materials.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.flare_enabled.tooltip: A subtle warm flare and faint ghosts from the sun, hidden behind terrain and clouds.
aurum.option.god_rays_enabled.tooltip: Light shafts from the sun through trees, terrain and cloud gaps. Strongest at golden hour.
aurum.option.clouds_enabled.tooltip: Soft, rounded, layered clouds (Story Mode style) in place of vanilla's. Uses the cloud shapes of your resource pack. The vanilla Clouds option set to Off turns them off too.
aurum.option.cloud_coverage.tooltip: How much of the sky the clouds cover in clear weather. 50% is vanilla.
aurum.option.cloud_shading.tooltip: How much the sun shapes the clouds: 0% flat colour, 100% lit tops and soft bellies.
aurum.option.pom_enabled.tooltip:
Carved depth on blocks close to you. High tier only.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.pom_depth.tooltip:
How deep the carved detail looks.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.pom_distance.tooltip:
POM fades out past this distance.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.tonemap.tooltip: How bright light is mapped to the screen. Aurum Filmic keeps colours true (no yellow shift). AgX is softer and shifts bright colours toward yellow.
aurum.option.vibrance.tooltip: Boosts muted colours more than already strong ones.
aurum.option.show_overlay.tooltip: Shows the GPU time of each render stage. Costs nothing when off. Key: F8.
aurum.option.waving_enabled.tooltip: Grass, flowers, crops, leaves and vines sway in the wind. Gusts roll across the land; rain and thunder make it stronger.
aurum.option.waving_strength.tooltip: How far plants and leaves move.
aurum.option.waving_speed.tooltip: How fast plants move and gusts travel.
aurum.option.white_balance.tooltip: Makes midday light neutral white, like a camera. Lower it for a warmer, more vintage look. Sunsets stay warm either way.
aurum.option.cloud_style.tooltip:
Blocky: dense rounded boxes in layers (Story Mode style).
Soft: fluffy, see-through clouds with high streaks (Better Clouds style).
aurum.option.clouds_full_res.tooltip: Draws clouds at full resolution instead of half: sharper up close, about 3-4x the cloud cost. On in High.
aurum.option.cloud_height.tooltip: Raises the clouds above vanilla's height (y 192).
aurum.option.cloud_speed.tooltip: How fast the clouds drift. 100% is three times vanilla's speed.
aurum.option.clouds_pack_shapes.tooltip: Off: Aurum's own cloud clusters. On: the layout from your resource pack's clouds.png (vanilla's long streaks).
aurum.option.sun_shape.tooltip: Round: a soft round disc. Square: a crisp Minecraft-style square sun with a soft square glow.
aurum.option.enabled.tooltip: Turns all of Aurum's visuals on or off (also F6). Off is plain Sodium, for comparing looks and FPS.
aurum.look.tooltip: Tunes Aurum's tones and small effects toward a popular shader style.
aurum.look.aurum.tooltip: Aurum's own look: warm golden hours, balanced daylight.
aurum.look.airy.tooltip: Soft and bright, neutral light, pale sky, haze and soft clouds, gentle colours.
aurum.look.clear.tooltip: Clean and crisp, neutral daylight, clear blue sky, very warm sunsets, soft clouds.
aurum.look.warm.tooltip: Warm all day, lavender-pink skies, warm shade, blocky clouds.
aurum.look.vivid.tooltip: Rich, cooler colours, deep blue sky, strong bloom and rays, deep orange sunsets.
aurum.look.custom.tooltip: You changed a look value by hand.
aurum.option.shade_warmth.tooltip: Cool blue or warm amber shadows.
aurum.option.sky_saturation.tooltip: Pale, near-white sky or deep, rich blue.
aurum.option.sky_lavender.tooltip: Golden (left) or lavender-pink (right) sky, strongest at sunrise and sunset.
aurum.option.pom_generated.tooltip: Gives every solid block pixel 3D from its own texture where your resource pack has no height map (wood, modded blocks). Applies after F3+T or a pack reload.
aurum.option.sky_clarity.tooltip: Keeps colour in the lower daytime sky. Does not retune sunlight or moonlight on blocks.
aurum.option.sky_temperature.tooltip: Cooler or warmer daytime sky, reflections and haze. Surface lighting keeps its existing temperature.
aurum.option.water_style.tooltip: Aurum: expressive waves and glitter. Calm Lake: gentler ripples, clear shallows and steadier reflected banks.
aurum.option.water_style_blend.tooltip: With Calm Lake selected: 0% is the original Aurum surface; 100% is the full lake treatment.
aurum.option.sharpness_enabled.tooltip: Adaptive terrain detail in the existing final composite. Leaves sky, bloom and light shafts unsharpened.
aurum.option.taa.tooltip: Blends each frame with the previous ones at slightly shifted positions: smooth edges, solid-looking leaves and no shimmer on distant textures. Costs one full-screen pass.
aurum.option.taa_sharpen.tooltip: Restores fine texture detail after anti-aliasing. Higher is crisper.
aurum.option.sharpness.tooltip: Strength of the restrained luminance sharpening filter. Turn down if fine textures shimmer while moving.
aurum.option.voxel_lighting.tooltip: Terrain and supported models share a directional 16-block incident-light field. With LambDynamicLights installed, both use propagated block light until a source adapter is available. Source overflow also uses that fallback.
aurum.option.voxel_lighting_strength.too: Blend the cached visibility result with vanilla block lighting.
aurum.option.voxel_detail.tooltip: 4 uses one-block probes; 8 uses half-block probes with eight times the probe count. Both include bounded neutral local bounce. Default 4 is the lower-cost choice.
aurum.option.cloud_motion_variation.tool: Cloud groups accelerate and slow in coherent wind bands. Zero restores uniform drift. Visible clouds and shadows share the motion.
aurum.option.cloud_shadows_enabled.toolt: Moving cloud footprints attenuate direct sunlight. Ambient skylight and moonlight remain.
aurum.option.cloud_shadow_strength.toolt: How much direct sunlight a cloud blocks. Cloud geometry and drift determine the footprint.
aurum.option.foliage_depth.tooltip: Preserve leaf-face direction and reduce sky fill inside dense crowns. Keeps biome and resource-pack colours.
aurum.option.distance_haze.tooltip: Distant land fades into the bright air near the horizon, which gives scenes depth. Nearby blocks are not affected. Warm toward a low sun.
aurum.option.biome_haze.tooltip: Extra mist in swamp biomes, including matching modded biome names. Lower values preserve forest colour and depth. Weather fog is controlled separately.
aurum.option.light_edge_style.tooltip: Natural: filtered penumbrae. Voxel Crisp: world-aligned sun/moon shadow cells, nearest local-light samples, and unblurred native-pixel shafts. Map resolution still limits geometric detail.
aurum.option.light_pixel_grid.tooltip: World-aligned cells per block in Voxel Crisp mode. 16 aligns with vanilla texture texels; 4 or 8 gives a chunkier pixel-art look. Local light uses Voxel shadow detail. Shafts use native 3-pixel cells.
